## Why visit

A specialist cider outing for travellers whose dates align with its limited public openings. This is a direct producer experience: a small Huddersfield cider maker using locally gathered apples and pears, with its own tasting room and shop. The appeal is discussing the fruit and cider with the people behind it, rather than finding an enormous pub beer list. It won Huddersfield CAMRA’s 2026 cider award. Because Lindley adds another connection beyond the main Manchester–Liverpool axis, make it a deliberate alternative day only when the opening is confirmed and cider is the priority.
